title: Last mountain day: double sustained climb, 2 x 500m
terrain: forested to open, 2 x ~500m D+, total D- ~1000m, non-technical descent line, no exposed crest

steps.target: Z3 sustained climb, 88-93% LTHR, ~500m D+ continuous

coachNotes: THE SWAP IS OFF, this is the big day and Sunday stays small. The 19 Aug model runs agree on Saturday and only on Saturday: 1-3mm across mountain-forecast and yr, meteoblue gives 5h of sun, the highest of the period, wind 10-15 km/h. Sunday scatters from 4 to 20mm and ARPA calls both days the same, so when the human forecaster does not separate two days and the models do, take the models on the relative call. Saturday it is. Session raised 140 -> 155 and D+ 800 -> 1000 because this is the last vertical before the race: week 7 is Milan and Belgium at 150m of D+ for the entire week, and the only other climbing weekend left is 5-6 September. TERRAIN: 65-107mm falls Thursday and Friday, so limestone will be soaked. No exposed crest, no cable sections, no slabby or polished rock, no steep step-down braking terrain. Pick a forested or grassy line that stays runnable at cadence 175+ even wet, and treat mud as the technical hazard it is. Two climbs of ~500m in one continuous push each, not fragments, Pirin's 3300m arrives in long sustained ascents. GATE: this goes at 155 / 1000m only if Thursday and Friday mornings are both clean on the lateral knee. Any signal and it is 1x500m climb plus flat, load 110, no negotiation. FUELLING REHEARSAL: eat every 40 minutes from the first climb, race products only, 2 x 500ml minimum. ELECTRICAL STORM FALLBACK: abort to the valley on the first thunder and finish flat, do not wait it out under the tree line. Garmin expect 250-300.
